_doc: MA-7-14: the body Photo Massing files. The mass names each photo it read as 'ev-NNNN sha256:<the blurred copy's sha256>'. Deviation from amendment 28 ({id, sha256} pairs): the entries are one-line strings, because a changeset element's evidence is a list of one-line texts (changesets-logic.mjs); ids alone are what the job rows (changeset_proposed/applied from_job) list, and a photo changeset has no job, so no row carries the compound entry (pinned in changesets-store.test.mjs). The bridge test (changesets-store.test.mjs) and the add-in's PackPhotos.Evidence (tools/massing-check) read this one file.
